verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Mercury acting as an MCP server: external AI assistants connect to https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp to reach Mercury data. Nothing shows Mercury itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers to use their tools. The server-side capability is a different role and cannot be credited, so this applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
